name: France
filingNote: Calendar tax year. The online return opens in April of the following year; the closing date differs by département.
lotRuleNote: No matching per lot: the gain on each taxable sale is computed on the whole portfolio (art. 150 VH bis III CGI).

card.classification: Gains on occasional sales by individuals (art. 150 VH bis CGI; from 1 January 2026, MiCA crypto-assets only; NFTs: art. 150 VH ter). Trading like a professional: non-commercial profits (BNC); as a business: commercial profits (BIC).

taxableEvents.note: Any sale for a currency with legal tender, whatever the holding period; taxed from the first euro once the household's sale prices for the year exceed EUR 305.
Deferred: a swap of one crypto-asset for another with no cash balancing payment (soulte) is not a taxable event; a swap with a balancing payment is taxable.
Paying for a good or a service with crypto is a taxable sale.
Not a sale for consideration: nothing is received in exchange.
Not a sale for consideration. For the recipient, the acquisition price is the value retained for the gift or inheritance duties (droits de mutation à titre gratuit, art. 150 VH bis III).
Rewards from mining or staking are taxed as non-commercial profits (BNC). Airdrops are not addressed by the tax office's FAQ (medium confidence).

rates.label: Flat rate (PFU)
rates.note: 12.8 % income tax plus 18.6 % social levies. An irrevocable option (box 3CN) puts the gains on the progressive scale.

allowances: No tax when the household's sale prices for the year (not the gains) total EUR 305 or less, deferred swaps left out; above EUR 305 every gain of the year is taxed (art. 150 VH bis II B).
Fees paid on a sale, with proof, reduce the sale price.
card.holdingRuleText: No holding-period rule: a sale for euros or a payment with crypto is taxable whatever the holding period, once the household's sale prices for the year exceed EUR 305. A swap of crypto for crypto with no balancing payment is deferred until a taxable sale.
card.lotRuleText: No matching per lot. The gain on a sale is the sale price minus the sale's share of the whole portfolio's total cost (total cost × sale price ÷ portfolio value just before the sale); that share then leaves the total cost for later sales.
card.losses: A loss offsets only gains of the same kind made in the same year; it does not carry forward to later years.
reporting: Form 2042 C: box 3AN for a net gain, 3BN for a net loss, 3CN to opt for the progressive scale.

Annexe 2086 lists every taxable sale: date, value of the whole portfolio, sale price, fees, total acquisition price, and the part of that price already used in earlier sales (the form's 'fractions de capital initial').
Form 3916-bis for every crypto account on a platform abroad.
caveats: The value of all your holdings at the moment of each sale.
The EUR 305 threshold, counted on sale prices.
Losses, usable in the same year only.
Declarations for platforms abroad and their fines.
The 2027 budget measures, which are not law yet.
card.summary60: France: selling crypto for euros or paying with crypto is taxable; swapping one crypto for another is not. Gains are taxed at a flat 31.4 %, or at your progressive rate on request. If your household's sales in a year total EUR 305 or less, nothing is due. Gains are computed on your whole portfolio, not per coin.

pendingChanges.title: Loi n° 2026-534 of 25 June 2026 against social and tax fraud, art. 91
pendingChanges.summary: Art. 150 VH bis now covers crypto-assets under Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (MiCA); the new art. 150 VH ter taxes unique, non-fungible crypto-assets (NFTs) under the rules of the asset they represent. Both apply to sales from 1 January 2026. Articles 1649 bis C and 1736 add NFTs held abroad to the account declarations and their fines.
